items.Sentence: the domestic wastewater gravity flows from the collection system through a manual bar screen into the aeration basin.
Wastewater is then treated in an extended aeration basin and the aeration blower is stopped to allow sludge to settle at the bottom.
After this, the wastewater is sent through a clarifier and then disinfected with 12.5% sodium hypochlorite in a contact tank.

This sludge is taken to the nearby Oakhurst Wastewater Treatment Plant for processing, dewatering, and disposal.
Solids collected from the manual bar screen are collected during normal operations and deposited into a disposal container. Once full, the container is disposed of at an approved landfill.
There is an unlined emergency pond connected at the Facility that is primarily used to capture any runoff from the spray fields.
